Menu

Four soups a day, cooked from scratch each morning — two classics and two gourmet. The board changes daily, so what is below is the shape of it rather than a fixed list.

Sizes, packs and extras

Sizes

  • Cup[$0.00]

    The everyday size. Lidded, with a spoon and a napkin.

  • Bowl[$0.00]

    Around half again. Ask at the counter.

  • Crusty roll[$0.00]

    Baked locally, delivered each morning.

Take home

  • Chilled 1L pack[$0.00]

    Whatever is left in the pots at 3pm, cooled down the same afternoon and sealed. Same soup, same day it was cooked. Feeds two or three.

Stock depends on what is left over, so packs sell out. Ring ahead if you want a particular soup put aside.

Dietary

  • Vegetarian — no meat or meat stock
  • Gluten free — no gluten-containing ingredient
  • Dairy free — no milk, cream or butter

Everything is cooked in one kitchen, so we cannot promise a soup is free of traces. Tell us at the counter if it matters and we will tell you exactly what went in the pot.

The board changes every weekday. When a soup runs out it is gone for the day.

Cash and card at the counter. Takeaway only — there is no seating.
